verdict.rationale: Vercel documents standard Git-push deployment and an official CLI (vercel-docs-1, vercel-gh-1, vercel-probe-4), supporting familiar Git/CLI workflows, but there is no evidence of first-class support for external CI pipelines or editor-agnostic tooling, and community feedback explicitly notes lock-in to the Next.js ecosystem and restricted language support (vercel-comm-7, vercel-comm-14), undercutting the 'no proprietary tooling' claim. missing for 10: explicit CI integration docs, framework-agnostic tooling evidence, editor-neutrality evidence, and rebuttal to lock-in complaints.
